positions.notes: DR-584 Schedule I: 81 current positions; annual rates total $4,256,607 at 9/30/26, budgeted $4,341,739 at 9/30/27 after $85,132 guideline increases (average ~$53,602/position, derived). Position-level detail is not itemized in the posted form.

leaders.name: Chuck Perdue
leaders.title: Tax Collector
leaders.notes: Base salary under Ch. 145, F.S.; officers who complete the statutory certification program may receive up to $2,000/yr special qualification salary on top (not included). The office's own FY2026-27 budget (dated 9/15/26, before EDR's FY27 figures) carries the official at $200,466 (= FY26 $198,466 + $2,000 special qualification); FY25-26 budget also shows $200,466 approved. Name from source 4.
